Synopsis:
    A second explosion hit an EMCO-operated weapons storage facility in Bulgaria within weeks, near Tsareva Livada. No casualties reported. EMCO is owned by arms trader Emilian Gebrev, a known target of alleged Russian sabotage operations. Bulgarian prosecutors link the pattern of attacks to Russian operatives, citing depot explosions between 2011–2020, an attempted poisoning in 2015, and connected incidents in the Czech Republic. The article points to a continuing, systematic campaign of disruption against munitions supplies destined for Ukraine.
